# ankra_organisation (Data Source)

One organisation with its members: by default the one requests act in (the provider's `organisation_id`, or the token's current organisation). The counterpart of `ankra org current` and `ankra org members`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_organisation" "current" {}

output "admins" {
  value = [for member in data.ankra_organisation.current.members : member.email if member.role == "admin"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Organisation id. Leave unset for the current organisation.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `members` (Attributes List) Members and pending invites. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--members))
- `mfa_required` (Boolean) Whether members must enrol in MFA.
- `name` (String) Organisation name.
- `slug` (String) URL slug.

<a id="nestedatt--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `members`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address; null for a machine identity.
- `id` (String) User id.
- `invite_id` (String) Identifier of the membership row.
- `role` (String) Role in the organisation.
- `status` (String) `active` or `pending`.
